task: W4-C3 — CANONICAL PENDING MODIFICATION REQUEST AUTHORITY

scope.slice: W4-C3: CANONICAL PENDING MODIFICATION REQUEST AUTHORITY ONLY
scope.historicalIntentContract: Durable internal pending request binding active reservation effective version to accepted-offer target quote

migration.strategy: Additive schema extension creating canonical_reservation_modification_requests table with composite foreign keys to W4-C1 sealed revisions and stays_quotes; atomic routine canonical_request_reservation_modification with authorization-before-replay order, PRESENT W1 commercial source-currentness check, wall-clock expiry check post-row-lock, deterministic command fingerprinting, and restricted execution role encho_modification_issuer

columns.reservation_id: UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES canonical_reservations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
columns.holder_principal: TEXT NOT NULL (no holder-principal table CHECK constraint or foreign key is defined; authority is enforced in canonical_request_reservation_modification which validates authenticated principal format, checks equality with canonical_reservations.holder_principal and stays_quotes.holder_principal, persists reservation holder, and is protected by table immutability trigger)
columns.target_quote_id: UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES stays_quotes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tableSchema.shapeConstraint: chk_modification_request_source_version_shape CHECK ((source_effective_version = 1 AND source_revision_id IS NULL) OR (source_effective_version >= 2 AND source_revision_id IS NOT NULL))
tableSchema.compositeRevisionFk: fk_modification_request_source_revision FOREIGN KEY (source_revision_id, reservation_id, source_effective_version) REFERENCES canonical_reservation_revisions(id, reservation_id, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT
tableSchema.sealFk: fk_modification_request_source_sealed FOREIGN KEY (source_revision_id) REFERENCES canonical_reservation_revision_seals(revision_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
tableSchema.immutability: Trigger canonical_reservation_modification_requests_immutable executes canonical_reservation_modification_requests_prevent_mutation() which raises CANONICAL_MODIFICATION_REQUEST_IMMUTABLE on UPDATE or DELETE
tableSchema.rowLevelSecurity: Enabled and forced: ALTER TABLE canonical_reservation_modification_requests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE canonical_reservation_modification_requests FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

functionSignature.name: canonical_request_reservation_modification
functionSignature.returns: TABLE (request_id UUID, reservation_id UUID, command_id UUID, holder_principal TEXT, source_effective_version INT, source_revision_id UUID, target_quote_id UUID, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, replayed BOOLEAN)
functionSignature.security: VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, public, pg_temp SET row_security = on
functionSignature.roleModel: REVOKE ALL FROM PUBLIC and all runtime roles; conditional GRANT EXECUTE to encho_modification_issuer when role exists with strictly pre-validated restricted privileges (no table DML, no schema create, no bypassrls, no superuser)
functionSignature.roleProvisioningNote: Migration 059 conditionally grants EXECUTE on canonical_request_reservation_modification only if role encho_modification_issuer already exists; disposable tests explicitly provision that restricted role; production/deployment role provisioning is NOT EVALUATED; no claim of production readiness is made.

architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step1_inputValidation: Rejects NULLs, malformed principals (^(user:[0-9]+|session:[0-9a-f-]{36})$), source version < 1
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step2_reservationLock: SELECT * FROM canonical_reservations WHERE id = target_reservation_id FOR UPDATE
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step5_fingerprintComputation: Deterministic SHA-256 over canonical JSONB payload (command_type, reservation_id, authenticated_principal, expected_source_effective_version, target_quote_id)
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step6_replayCheck: Authorization-before-replay order: verifies existing command_id under locked reservation; if fingerprint matches, returns stored result with replayed = true BEFORE mutable gates; if fingerprint differs, raises MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step9_mutableGateTargetQuote: stays_quotes must exist, quote_kind = 'ACCEPTED_OFFER', matching holder principal, matching listing_id
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step10_mutableGateOfferPointer: Locks sellable_offers FOR UPDATE; verifies quote_row.offer_revision matches offer_ptr.current_accepted_revision and public_disposition = 'ACCEPTED'; checks static listing/room coherence, date window, occupancy, currency, and arithmetic
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step11_mutableGatePresentSourceFacts: Recomputes PRESENT W1 source snapshot via public.sellable_offer_source_snapshot(listing_id, room_type_id); recomputes current_source_hash and current_media_hash; checks against offer_rev_row and verifies approved media URLs are safe; raises MODIFICATION_OFFER_SOURCE_STALE on mismatch or unsafe URL (live inventory check: NONE)
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step12_mutableGateWallClockExpiry: Checks stays_quotes.expires_at <= clock_timestamp() strictly AFTER acquiring reservation and offer row locks (distinction: request created_at column default uses statement_timestamp(), while quote expiry gate uses clock_timestamp())
architecturalGatesAndOrdering.step13_atomicInsertion: Attempts INSERT into canonical_reservation_modification_requests; catches EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN; recovers existing command row by command_id under locked reservation; validates reservation_id, holder_principal, command_fingerprint, source_effective_version, and target_quote_id identity; returns stored result with replayed = true if identical or raises MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT if any parameter differs

focusedTestResults.summary: Focused W4-C3 Node test: PASS 1/1; internally contains 32 labeled scenario sections A–AF

frozenRequirementCoverage.evidence: Case A: ACTIVE Encho Direct V1 reservation + fresh quote + matching holder succeeds, persists request row with source_effective_version = 1, source_revision_id IS NULL; zero inventory mutation, zero target holds, zero revisions
Case B: Sealed V2 source captures exact source_revision_id FK; unsealed V3 ignored; persists row with source_effective_version = 2 and exact sealed revision UUID
Case C: Target expected source version mismatching reservation effective version rejected with MODIFICATION_SOURCE_VERSION_MISMATCH
Case D: Reservation in CANCELLATION_REQUESTED lifecycle state rejected for NEW modification request with MODIFICATION_LIFECYCLE_CONFLICT
Case E: Reservation in CANCELLED lifecycle state rejected for NEW modification request with MODIFICATION_LIFECYCLE_CONFLICT
Case F: Quote with expires_at in the past rejected with MODIFICATION_QUOTE_EXPIRED
Case G: Quote that expires during lock acquisition evaluated using post-lock wall clock (clock_timestamp()) and rejected with MODIFICATION_QUOTE_EXPIRED
Case H: Reservation holder (user:10) attempting to bind target quote belonging to different holder (user:11) rejected with MODIFICATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED
Case I: Foreign principal (user:99) attempting to create or replay existing command ID on reservation held by user:10 rejected with MODIFICATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED without disclosing stored request
Case J: Quote with quote_kind != 'ACCEPTED_OFFER' rejected with MODIFICATION_QUOTE_KIND_INVALID
Case K: Target quote referencing different listing (listing 2 != reservation listing 1) rejected with MODIFICATION_LISTING_MISMATCH

Case L: Target quote referencing room_type_id (201) not belonging to target offer (101) rejected with MODIFICATION_QUOTE_INCOHERENT (supplementary date/guest/amount arithmetic coherence checks in Gate 4 verified by SQL_REVIEW)
Case M: Target quote referencing historical revision 1 when offer's current_accepted_revision has advanced to 2 rejected with MODIFICATION_OFFER_SUPERSEDED

Case AD: Valid quote with un-superseded pointer rejected for NEW request with MODIFICATION_OFFER_SOURCE_STALE when present W1 source facts drift (mutated room_types.name causes W1 to report OFFER_STALE_REVIEW); zero rows inserted

Case AF: Source reservation on listing 1, room 101; target quote on same listing 1, different room 102; all required target commercial checks valid; request succeeds; zero target inventory reserved, zero target holds created, zero reservation revisions published
Case O: Exact idempotent replay returns stored request with replayed = true, identical request_id, and identical created_at
Case P: Replay of committed command after target quote expires succeeds without re-evaluating quote expiry, returning replayed = true
Case Q: Replay of committed command after offer pointer advances to revision 3 succeeds without re-evaluating offer pointer, returning replayed = true

Case AE: C3 request commits while source is current; present W1 source fact later drifts causing W1 to report OFFER_STALE_REVIEW; exact same command replays without re-evaluating source currentness, returning original request ID with replayed = true and no new row
Case R: Request committed while ACTIVE; reservation transitions to CANCELLATION_REQUESTED; exact replay returns historical stored request with replayed = true
Case S: Same command ID presented with changed target quote rejected with MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT
Case T: Same command ID presented with changed expected source version rejected with MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT
Case U: Same command ID presented with changed caller principal (user:99) rejected with MODIFICATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED without disclosure
Case V: Same command ID presented against a different reservation (resV2) rejected with MODIFICATION_COMMAND_CONFLICT

Case W: Concurrent identical commands converge to exactly 1 durable request row; one caller receives original result (replayed = false) and the other receives replay (replayed = true) (unique_violation exception handler path verified by SQL_REVIEW / CONTROL-FLOW REVIEW)
Case X: Distinct command IDs issued concurrently against same reservation both succeed and persist distinct request rows

Case AB: Table trigger canonical_reservation_modification_requests_immutable unconditionally rejects UPDATE and DELETE with CANONICAL_MODIFICATION_REQUEST_IMMUTABLE even when executed by table owner (structural shape enforced by SCHEMA_CONSTRAINT chk_modification_request_source_version_shape)
Case Z: Quote with identical stay dates and room type succeeds cleanly as historical intent evidence with zero side effects

Case AB: encho_modification_issuer has EXECUTE on function and NO direct SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on request table; unprivileged runtime roles have NO EXECUTE and NO INSERT on request table (broader restriction across unrelated tables established by SQL_REVIEW of migration 059 section 8)

SQL_REVIEW of canonical_request_reservation_modification function body in migration 059 demonstrates only DML target is canonical_reservation_modification_requests; supplementary runtime test Case AA verifies zero row count changes across inventory_days, booking_holds, canonical_reservations, and revisions

Case AC dual evidence: DIFF_REVIEW confirms git diff --name-only affc14b185dedb3d54a3c414876f98f0f3e85061...HEAD touches only 3 files (0 files in src/server or src/routes); CALLER_SEARCH confirms git grep -n 'canonical_request_reservation_modification' src/ finds zero application/runtime callers outside migration 059 and tests

SQL_REVIEW of migration 059 and existing codebase demonstrates zero routines capable of publishing reservation revisions exist; no role has UPDATE/INSERT privilege on canonical_reservation_revisions outside migration scripts (not an assertion in Case AC)
